description: This file defines TypeScript schemas and functions for validating, normalizing, and transforming JSON Schema objects, particularly for compatibility with OpenAI's structured output requirements and other providers. It includes schema definitions, transformation logic, and utility functions for handling JSON Schema draft 2020-12 features.

methods.name: applyArrayProperties
methods.description: Copies array-specific JSON Schema properties from source to target object if they are defined.

methods.name: normalizeToolSchema
methods.description: Normalizes a JSON Schema object to be compliant with JSON Schema draft 2020-12, including flattening top-level composition keywords, converting deprecated type arrays, stripping unsupported formats, and setting additionalProperties to false for object schemas.
